_comment: Single source of truth for Kev routing: GiTrust (include_str! in src/kev.rs) and the eval/training harness (docs/classifier_eval/kev_ops.py) both load THIS file. ORDER AND WORDING ARE LOAD-BEARING: Kev was fine-tuned on exactly these option strings in exactly this order; editing either invalidates the training data and the eval.
instructions: A developer typed this request into a Git assistant. Which single Git operation are they asking for? If it is not about Git, choose __reject__.
ops: status
Show the working tree status: which files are modified, staged or untracked. Local only.
log
List the history of past commits.
diff
Show the line-by-line changes in the working files.
branches
List the existing branches or report which branch is currently checked out.
config
Show Git configuration such as the user name and email.
show
Show the details of one single commit (author, date, message, files).
fetch
Contact the remote to find out whether the local branch is ahead of or behind it, without changing local files.
merge_preview
Predict, without changing anything, whether pulling or merging would produce conflicts.
add_commit
Stage all changes (or the named files) and create a commit.
commit
Commit only the files that are already staged.
push
Upload the current branch's commits to the remote, everything, no filtering.
scoped_push
Commit and push only the files belonging to one named feature or topic (for example the files about one area of the code).
branch
Create a new branch with a given name.
checkout
Switch to a different existing branch.
pull
Download and integrate the latest commits from the remote into the current branch.
sync
Bring another branch (usually main) into the current feature branch to update it.
undo
Undo one recent commit, or any request to undo / take back / roll back that leaves open how to undo it.
amend
Change the most recent commit, e.g. rewrite its message or add a forgotten file.
squash
Combine several recent commits into a single commit.
revert
Create a new commit that reverses an earlier commit, keeping history intact.
unstage
Remove files from the staging area without changing their contents.
stash
Temporarily shelve uncommitted changes to get a clean working tree.
cleanup
Discard uncommitted work in the working tree (modified and/or untracked files) to start fresh.
discard_local
Throw away local commits that are not on the remote by resetting the branch to the remote's version.
force_push
Push while overwriting the remote branch's history with the local version.
init
Create a new Git repository in this folder.
add_remote
Add or set the URL of a remote repository.
find_lost_work
Search for and recover lost or deleted commits.
remotes
List the configured remote repositories and their URLs.
stash_pop
Bring back the most recently stashed changes into the working tree.
pull_rebase
Pull the remote's commits and replay my local commits on top of them (rebase instead of merge).
set_upstream
Make the current branch track a branch on the remote.
remove_remote
Remove a configured remote from this repository.
delete_repo
Delete this folder's Git repository (the .git directory), keeping the files.
commit_push
Stage all changes (or the named files), commit them and push to the remote, in one go.
__reject__
Not a request about Git or version control at all.

in_progress._comment: Asked ONLY when the repo is mid-operation (Layer 0 situation), before the main question. Same load-bearing order/wording rule.
in_progress.instructions: A Git operation is in progress in this repository. Does the developer's request control that operation (continue, skip or abort it)? If not, choose something_else.

rebase: Continue the rebase in progress, after the conflicts are resolved.
Skip the commit the rebase stopped on and carry on with the rest.
Cancel the rebase and go back to how the branch was before it started.
merge: Cancel the merge in progress and go back to before it started.
cherry_pick: Continue the cherry-pick in progress, after the conflicts are resolved.
Cancel the cherry-pick and go back to before it started.
revert: Continue the revert in progress, after the conflicts are resolved.
Cancel the revert and go back to before it started.

other: Anything else: the request is not about continuing, skipping or aborting the operation in progress.
